title: EvolVE: Evolutionary Search for LLM-based Verilog Generation and Optimization

mechanism.domainTask: Verilog functional generation and hardware PPA optimization
mechanism.populationDetail: MCTS maintains a candidate tree, while IGR maintains multiple independent refinement chains within a growing node set.
mechanism.archiveDetail: Algorithm 1 updates an archive of best solutions on score improvement but gives no archive size or precise admission rule.
mechanism.replacementDetail: Every evaluated child is added to the node set; MCTS also inserts it into the tree, while an improvement-based best archive is updated separately.
mechanism.generationDetail: The initial RTL is generated from scratch; IGR applies differential edits to one chain parent; MCTS improves one selected leaf's code.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: STG yields fine-grained test-vector pass fractions; PPA guidance combines diagnosis with a fast area-latency proxy.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: IGR ideas and retrieved papers are guidance, not true code parents; MCTS chooses a tree leaf, IGR uses the chain's latest node.

provenance.sourcePdf: papers/EVOLVE Evolutionary Search for LLM-based Verilog Generation and Optimization.pdf
provenance.citationWarning: No current Survey/sections citation uses this BibTeX key. Archive size/admission and MCTS edit locality are underspecified; strategy selection is task-configured rather than an online switch.
